license_evidence.title: Dragon’s Mouth
license_evidence.license_basis: The artist supplied this file and explicitly requested publication to Atrium; this is display permission, not a Creative Commons grant.
license_evidence.derivative_provenance: Converted the USD crate to equivalent ASCII with Apple usdcat, preserving meshes and texture bytes; imported with Three.js USDLoader and exported as self-contained GLB. Removed internal capture paths and metadata. Applied uniform scale to the artist-stated approximate height. Optimized with meshopt and 2048-pixel WebP textures without geometry simplification.
license_evidence.dimensions_basis: Approximate artist-supplied height of 25.4 cm; width and depth estimated from model proportions. Creation year and country not supplied.
license_evidence.dedup_review: Artist name and title checked against all1545 baseline records; no prior Michael Conor Kushman work or this composition.

visual_review.geometry_notes: Original converted model and optimized model reviewed from front, rear and both sides. Continuous crumpled and folded metal form; pale/pink surfaces, dark reverse and cavities retained. No surrounding floor or mount was removed; no generated geometry or filled surfaces.
visual_review.optimization: No triangle simplification; texture compression and meshopt only.
visual_review.conversion_audit: USD19,918faces retained; expanded positions bit-exact, normals/UVs agree within3e-8 float rounding; basecolor/normal/AO2048² pixels match before optimization after expected textureflip.

dimensions_review.note: Height is approximate and supplied by the artist. Width and depth are estimated from the scan’s proportions; these are not independent physical measurements.
dimensions_review.spatialNote: Approximate height supplied by the artist; the model’s proportions are preserved.

exhibition_placements.text: Michael Conor Kushman’s folded aluminum sets pale paint and pink accents against darker recesses. Ridges, creases, and the open cavity turn the painted surface into a changing sequence of planes.
